definitions.gloss: drainage; water permeability; how well water drains
definitions.explanation: The ability of soil, ground, or a surface to allow water to drain away. Commonly discussed in gardening, agriculture, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: この{土|つち}は{水|みず}はけが{良|よ}い。
{水|みず}はけの{悪|わる}い{場所|ばしょ}に{水|みず}たまりができた。
examples.english: Puddles formed in places with poor drainage.

examples.japanese: {花壇|かだん}の{水|みず}はけを{良|よ}くするために、{砂利|じゃり}を{混|ま}ぜた。
examples.english: I mixed in gravel to improve the drainage of the flower bed.

notes:
Composed of {水|みず} (water) + はけ (draining away). Can also be written {水捌|みずは}け. Almost always appears in the patterns {水|みず}はけが{良|よ}い (good drainage) or {水|みず}はけが{悪|わる}い (poor drainage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}はけが{良|よ}い: good drainage
- {水|みず}はけが{悪|わる}い: poor drainage
- {水|みず}はけを{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve drainage
- {水|みず}はけの{良|よ}い{土|つち}: well-draining soil

USAGE:
Essential vocabulary for gardening in Japanese. Many plants require {水|みず}はけの{良|よ}い{土|つち} (well-draining soil), making this a practical word for anyone interested in Japanese gardening or agriculture.
